remarks: Welcome to 30 Kermit Avenue, a roomy two-story home with 1,932 square feet of living space and plenty of classic Buffalo character. Rehabbed by Habitat for Humanity in 2007, this three bedroom, one and a half bathroom home offers a large open kitchen with plenty of counter space and cherry cabinets. There is a separate dining area and sliding glass doors which open to the large back deck. The large living room has a decorative fireplace mantle and lots of windows.  Finishing out the first floor is a half bath, enclosed front porch and entry way with coat closet.  The second floor has three nice size bedrooms and a full bathroom with tub.  There is a finished third floor, too. The dry basement has glass block windows, circuit breakers and a sump pump. The hot water tank is newer and the forced hot air furnace is approximately 20 years old.  Step outside to a deep, private, fully fenced-in yard with room to relax, play, or entertain. Whether you’re searching for a place to call home or your next investment, this property is full of potential.
